heading: Sunday Night
text: Showers south petering off before dark, partial clearing northeast overnight. Fog, dense in the early morning. Lows in the low to mid 40s, near 40 in the cold spots. Winds reversing northerly overnight around 5 mph.

heading: Monday
text: A mix of sun and clouds. Highs from the upper 50s to low 60s, mid to upper 60s in the southern valleys. North wind increasing to 5 to 10 mph east, west of the Green Mountains 10 north winds gusting to 20.

heading: Monday Night
text: Increasing clouds overnight. Slight chance of drizzle south of route 4. Lows from the upper 30s to mid 40s.
